name: Affect Therapeutics
one_liner: App-based addiction and mental health care: video visits with a therapist and prescriber, plus rewards for meeting recovery goals.
best_for: Adults using stimulants, opioids, alcohol or cannabis who want treatment from their phone
People with Medicaid, Medicare or commercial insurance in a state Affect serves
People who are motivated by earning rewards for staying on track (contingency management)
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988
People who need medical detox, residential or in-person care
People without insurance (no self-pay price is published)
short_description: Affect delivers substance use and mental health treatment through an app, combining therapy, medication, peer support and contingency-management.
long_description: Affect (formerly Affect Therapeutics) is a US telehealth provider that treats substance use disorders and, since 2025, mental health conditions such as depression, anxiety, PTSD and OCD. Treatment runs through its iOS and Android app: you meet a therapist and a medical professional by video, can receive medication for addiction treatment, get peer support, and earn points for meeting daily goals (contingency management). It bills insurance, including Medicaid and Medicare plans; no self-pay price is published. Availability is state by state; its own timeline lists launches in about 19 states between 2021 and 2024, and it raised a $26 million round in November 2025. Contingency management, CBT and medication for addiction treatment are evidence-based, but no peer-reviewed study of Affect's own program was found.

pricing.starting_price: Copay with insurance (Medicaid, Medicare and commercial plans); self-pay price not published
pricing.notes: Coverage depends on your plan and state; check eligibility at sign-up.

privacy.notes: Says it does not sell or share personal information under the CCPA; treatment records are covered by HIPAA and 42 CFR Part 2 under a separate notice; anyone can request deletion.

seo.meta_description: Affect Therapeutics provides virtual substance use treatment combining medication, therapy, and peer support for alcohol and opioid addiction.

faqs.q: What addictions does Affect Therapeutics treat?
faqs.a: Affect specializes in alcohol use disorder and opioid use disorder. Treatment includes FDA-approved medications like Suboxone and naltrexone combined with therapy and peer support.
Yes, Affect accepts many insurance plans including Medicaid in several states. Contact them to verify your specific coverage. Treatment for substance use disorder is often covered by insurance.

Affect uses evidence-based approaches: FDA-approved medications combined with behavioral therapy, which is the gold standard for addiction treatment. Outcomes track retention and substance use reduction.

faqs.q: How does virtual addiction treatment work?
faqs.a: You have video appointments with prescribers for medication management, therapy sessions with counselors, and ongoing support from peer recovery coaches. All care is delivered virtually through your phone or computer.

primary_uses: Stimulant, opioid, alcohol and cannabis use treatment
Contingency management rewards for recovery goals
Medication for addiction treatment by telehealth
Therapy for depression, anxiety or PTSD alongside substance use

patient_summary: You download the Affect app, check that your insurance and state are covered, and then meet a therapist and a prescriber by video. Between visits you complete daily goals in the app and earn rewards for progress. It is billed to your insurance, including Medicaid in many states.

availability.note: Only in states where Affect is licensed (about 19 launched by 2024, per its own timeline); check your state at sign-up.
